svg.title: Switch spacing
svg.desc: The thumb stretches on hover and press, then releases and slides once from off to on as the track and thumb change tone; the final checked state is static under reduced motion. A checked Switch with its Enable notifications label, drawn at three times CSS size. The track is 36 by 20 pixels, the circular thumb is 16 pixels across, the outer inset is 2 pixels, and the label gap is 8 pixels.
